results.problem: Preconditioned linear system for 1D space-time fractional diffusion inverse problem
results.quote:
With A_N as in (6.11) and P_N as in (6.15), it holds
\{P_N^{-1}A_N\}_N\sim_{\mathrm{GLT},\sigma} 1.
Moreover,
\{P_N^{-1}A_N\}_N\sim_\lambda 1.

results.problem: Preconditioned linear system for 2D space-time fractional diffusion inverse problem
results.quote:
With A_{\widetilde{\mathbf{N}}} as in (7.18) and P_{\widetilde{\mathbf{N}}} as in (7.22), it holds
\{P_{\widetilde{\mathbf{N}}}^{-1}A_{\widetilde{\mathbf{N}}}\}_{\widetilde{\mathbf{N}}}\sim_{\mathrm{GLT},\sigma} 1.
Moreover,
\{P_{\widetilde{\mathbf{N}}}^{-1}A_{\widetilde{\mathbf{N}}}\}_{\widetilde{\mathbf{N}}}\sim_\lambda 1.

results.problem: Structure-preserving preconditioning for variable-coefficient space-fractional diffusion equation (1D)
results.quote:
Let P_{N,M}\in\{\widetilde{P}_{\alpha,N,M},\widehat{P}_{\alpha,N,M}\}, as defined in (8.35) and in (8.36), respectively. Then,
\{P_{N,M}\}_{N,M}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}\gamma^*\hat{d}f_\alpha(\xi_1)+q_\theta(\xi_3),
with \hat{d}=\int_\Omega a(x) and d=d_N converging to \hat{d} as N tends to infinity and
\{P_{N,M}^{-1}A_{\alpha,N,M}\}_{N,M}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}\frac{\gamma^*a(x)f_\alpha(\xi_1)+q_\theta(\xi_3)}{\gamma^*\hat{d}f_\alpha(\xi_1)+q_\theta(\xi_3)}.

results.problem: Structure-preserving preconditioning for variable-coefficient space-fractional diffusion equation (2D)
results.quote:
Let P\in\{\widetilde{P}_{\unknown,\mathbf{n},M},\widehat{P}_{\unknown,\mathbf{n},M}\}, as defined in (8.39) and in (8.40), respectively. Then,
\{P_{\mathbf{n},M}\}_{\mathbf{n},M}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}\hat{d}(\gamma_1^*f_{\alpha_1}(\xi_1)+\gamma_2^*f_{\alpha_2}(\xi_2))+q_\theta(\xi_3),
with \hat{d}=\int_\Omega a(x_1,x_2) and d=d_\mathbf{n} converging to \hat{d} as \mathbf{n} tends to infinity, and
\{P_{\mathbf{n},M}^{-1}A_{\mathbf{n},M}\}_{\mathbf{n},M}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}\frac{\gamma^*a(x_1,x_2)(\gamma_1^*f_{\alpha_1}(\xi_1)+\gamma_2^*f_{\alpha_2}(\xi_2))+q_\theta(\xi_3)}{\gamma^*\hat{d}(\gamma_1^*f_{\alpha_1}(\xi_1)+\gamma_2^*f_{\alpha_2}(\xi_2))+q_\theta(\xi_3)},
where necessarily \gamma_2^*=0 if \alpha_1>\alpha_2 and alternatively \gamma_1^*=0 if \alpha_2>\alpha_1.

results.problem: Geometric mean of HPD GLT matrix sequences (scalar case)
results.previous_best: Requires at least one of \kappa and \xi nonzero almost everywhere (Theorem 9.1)
results.quote:
Let r=1 and d\ge 1. Assume \{A_\mathbf{n}\}_\mathbf{n}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}\kappa and \{B_\mathbf{n}\}_\mathbf{n}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}\xi, where A_\mathbf{n},B_\mathbf{n}\in\mathcal{P}_\mathbf{n} for every multi-index \mathbf{n}. Then
\{G(A_\mathbf{n},B_\mathbf{n})\}_\mathbf{n}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}(\kappa\xi)^{1/2},
\{G(A_\mathbf{n},B_\mathbf{n})\}_\mathbf{n}\sim_{\sigma,\lambda}(\kappa\xi)^{1/2}.

results.problem: Geometric mean of HPD GLT matrix sequences (block case, commuting symbols)
results.previous_best: Requires at least one symbol invertible a.e. (Theorem 9.3)
results.quote:
Let r>1 and d\ge 1. Assume that \{A_\mathbf{n}\}_\mathbf{n}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}\kappa and \{B_\mathbf{n}\}_\mathbf{n}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}\xi, where A_\mathbf{n},B_\mathbf{n}\in\mathcal{P}_\mathbf{n} for every multi-index \mathbf{n}, with \mathcal{P}_\mathbf{n} denoting the set of HPD matrices of size rN(\mathbf{n}). Under the assumption that \kappa and \xi commute we infer
\{G(A_\mathbf{n},B_\mathbf{n})\}_\mathbf{n}\sim_\mathrm{GLT}(\kappa\xi)^{1/2},
\{G(A_\mathbf{n},B_\mathbf{n})\}_\mathbf{n}\sim_{\sigma,\lambda}(\kappa\xi)^{1/2}.
